subject: Agent DevTools as the default agent-local project runtime
statement: When an agent has executable access to a project checkout with Agent DevTools installed, it should use the Agent DevTools lifecycle as its normal working runtime (`begin` → project-native work/cognition as needed → verification → `work complete`) in its own local session, rather than merely following the methodology informally. This is the preferred dogfood model for developing Agent DevTools itself.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Capture agreed durable conclusions about multi-agent runtime ownership and dogfood
